data.content: {"story":{"as_a":"user managing my to-do list","i_want":"to delete a task only after I confirm the deletion","so_that":"I do not remove a task by accident and I see whether the deletion succeeded","business_description":"Users can delete a task from the task list. A confirmation prompt must be accepted before the deletion is sent, and the interface shows a success or error message based on the backend result. The task list changes only after the backend confirms the deletion.","business_value":"Prevents accidental data loss and keeps the displayed list consistent with the stored data.","acceptance_criteria":[{"given":"A task is shown in the task list","when":"The user chooses the delete action for that task","then":"A confirmation prompt is shown, the task is still shown in the list, and no delete request has been sent"},{"given":"The confirmation prompt is shown for a task","when":"The user cancels the prompt","then":"No delete request is sent and the task remains unchanged in the list"},{"given":"The confirmation prompt is shown for an existing task","when":"The user confirms the deletion and the backend returns a success response","then":"The task is removed from the list and a success message is displayed"},{"given":"The user has confirmed the deletion and the delete request is still in progress","when":"The user views the task list","then":"The task still appears in the list because the frontend does not remove it before the backend confirms the deletion"},{"given":"The user has confirmed the deletion of a task","when":"The backend returns an error response","then":"The task remains in the list and an error message is displayed instead of a success message"},{"given":"A delete request is sent for a task ID that does not exist in the database","when":"The backend processes the request","then":"The backend returns a task not found error and no task data is changed"},{"given":"A delete request fails because of an internal server or database error","when":"The backend processes the request","then":"The backend returns an error response and the stored task is not removed"}],"edge_cases":["The wording of the confirmation prompt and of the success and error messages is not specified.","The task is deleted by another session before the user confirms; the backend returns a not found error and the interface shows an error message."],"dependencies":[],"definition_of_done":["All acceptance criteria are demonstrated in a test run","Deletion happens only after the user accepts the confirmation prompt","The task list never shows a successful deletion before the backend confirms it"]},"revised_tasks":[],"added_requirements":[]}
